Title: 157. A World Apart
description: 1963. Thirteen year old Molly Roth, the eldest of three offspring of Gus and Diana Roth, lives a carefree life as part of the affluent white minority in South Africa. Race is a non-issue for her as although, under apartheid, the Roths largely exist among other white people like them, she feels equally comfortable around the black people in her life, such as their servants and her parents' black friends. Beyond knowing that they are busy in their work, Molly is unaware of the full extent of what her parents do, Gus a leading member of the South African Communist Party and Ruth an anti-apartheid journalist who also secretly works for the underground in support of the outlawed African National Congress. Shortly after Gus quietly escapes the country to evade probable arrest by the government - Molly believing it just a short work related trip - Molly's carefree life starts to unravel when Diana is detained for ninety days under a new law that allows such detention without ever even being charged with a criminal offense. The goal of Diana's interrogators, led by Inspector Muller, is to get her to divulge details especially of the underground, most specifically proverbial "names". Beyond missing her mother, Molly begins to resent the anti-apartheid work which has directly and indirectly impacted her life in a negative way, she wanting a mother, not an activist-mother. As the situation with Diana evolves, which includes someone needing to act as caregivers to Molly and her younger sisters while Diana is in detention, Molly gets a broader perspective of her situation under apartheid as she is able to see more of life just outside her protected white enclave, and as she is made aware of what Diana is trying to achieve for society in her work.

description: The wife's affair and a death in the family hasten the demise of an upper-class English marriage.

Title: 170. Two Moon Junction
description: A young Southern débutante temporarily abandons her posh lifestyle and upcoming, semi-arranged marriage to have a lustful and erotic fling with a rugged drifter who works at a local carnival.

Title: 171. Pascali's Island
description: 1908: Basil Pascali (Sir Ben Kingsley), a spy for the Sultan, sends reports to Istanbul that nobody reads. His suspicions are roused when a British archeologist appears, who may not be quite what he seems.

Title: 172. Platoon Leader
description: A young officer, just out of West Point is sent to Vietnam, where the men don't respect him until he gets wounded and returns to be a wiser soldier and a better commander

Title: 173. The Navigator: A Medieval Odyssey
description: Men seeking relief from the Black Death, guided by a boy's vision, dig a tunnel from 14th century England to 20th century New Zealand.

Title: 174. Midnight Crossing
description: Academy Award -winner Faye Dunaway, Daniel j. Travanti, John Laughlin (CRIMES OF PASSION), Kim Cattrall (MANNEQUIN) and Ned Beatty (THE FOURTH PROTOCOL) star in a twisted suspense thriller of murder, lust and greed.

Title: 175. Apartment Zero
description: In early 1980s Buenos Aires, a struggling movie theater owner takes in a roommate but suspects he is responsible for a series of political assassinations.

Title: 176. Little Vera
description: A teenage girl, who has just finished school feels trapped and aimless in her ordinary Russian family, supported by an alcoholic father, in a dull industrial town.

Title: 177. Patty Hearst
description: In the 1970s, Patricia Hearst is abducted by American revolutionaries, but eventually joins their cause instead.

Title: 178. Mr. North
description: After gaining a reputation as a mysterious healer, a charming Yale graduate must defend his honor before his unique talent lands him in jail.

Title: 179. A Time of Destiny
description: A modernized version of the story which inspired Verdi's opera, "La Forza del Destino".

Title: 180. The Thin Blue Line
description: A film that successfully argued that a man was wrongly convicted for murder by a corrupt justice system in Dallas County, Texas.

Title: 181. High Hopes
description: The life of a working class couple living in London and their complicated relationships with other members of the family.

Title: 182. The Lair of the White Worm
description: When an archaeologist uncovers a strange skull in a foreign land, the residents of a nearby town begin to disappear, leading to further inexplicable occurrences.

Title: 183. The Wrong Guys
description: Cub Scout Pack 18 organizes a 25-year reunion to relive their fond boyhood memories. But when the five friends meet for a camping trip, they discover that what little they had once known about wilderness survival has dwindled to nothing.

Title: 184. Miracle Mile
description: A young man hears a chance phone call telling him that a nuclear war has started and missiles will hit the city within 70 minutes.

Title: 185. Heathers
description: At Westerburg High where cliques rule, jocks dominate and all the popular girls are named Heather, it's going to take a Veronica and mysterious new kid to give teen angst a body count.

Title: 186. The Music Teacher
description: Aging opera singer Joachim Dallayrac retires from the stage and retreats to the countryside to school two young singers, Sophie and Jean. Although the rigorous training takes its toll on both teacher and students, there is plenty of time for relationships to develop between the three. Based on their teacher's reputation, Sophie and Jean are invited to participate in a singing contest staged by Prince Scotti. Scotti's protege is set up to get revenge for Scotti's defeat at the hands of Dallayrac in a similar competition many years ago. The young students overcome Scotti's trickery to win the competition.

Title: 187. The Little Thief
description: In a small town in post-World-War-II France, an unhappy sixteen-year-old (Janine Castang) tries to escape her dreary situation by any means at her disposal. Three successive friends (Michel Davenne, a married lover; Raoul, a fellow thief; Mauricette Dargelos, a photographer and fellow prisoner) help her learn from her mistakes.

Title: 188. Appointment with Death
description: When a former prison wardress who dominates the lives of her three adult stepchildren and her daughter is found dead at an archaeological dig near the Dead Sea, there are a great many suspects.

Title: 189. Watchers
description: A boy befriends a stray dog that is being hunted by a dangerous creature and a ruthless government agent.

Title: 190. Parents
description: A young boy living in 1950s suburbia suspects that his parents are cannibalistic murderers.

Title: 191. Waxwork
description: A wax museum owner uses his horror exhibits to unleash evil on the world.

Title: 192. The Boost
description: A real estate developer who enjoyed short-lived success seeks to regain his edge by using cocaine, but takes himself to new lows as he gets lost in the downward spiral of drug addiction.

Title: 193. The Girl in a Swing
description: London art broker travels to Copenhagen, hires trilingual secretary. Despite knowing little about her, they marry. Her past mysteriously resurfaces after marriage, straining their relationship as he navigates the situation.

Title: 194. Vampire's Kiss
description: After an encounter with a neck-biter, a publishing executive thinks that he's turning into a vampire.

Title: 195. And God Created Woman
description: Aspiring and incarcerated rock singer, Robin Shea (Rebecca De Mornay) seduces hardworking carpenter Billy Moran (Vincent Spano). Robin marries Billy to get out of jail, but Robin's concerns are on politician James Tiernan (Frank Langella).

Title: 196. The Reader
description: A multi-faceted film based on Raymond Jean's novel "La Lectrice". Constance (Miou-Miou) reads the novel aloud in bed to her lover. Inspired by the story of Marie, a woman who advertises her services as a reader of literature, Constance decides to do the same. Here the film takes on a kaleidoscopic effect as the lives of Constance and Marie become merged, making it hard to distinguish what is real and what is fantasy. This structure is further complicated when the lives of Constance's clients become tangled with the stories she reads. The film is interspersed with readings from well known literary sources as diverse as, amongst others, Baudelaire, Duras, Tolstoy, Lewis Carroll and de Sade's "120 days..."

Title: 197. Split Decisions
description: When a boxer is killed because he wouldn't take a dive, his brother tries to find a way to avenge him even if only symbolically.

Title: 198. Distant Voices, Still Lives
description: The lives of an English working-class family are told out of order in a free-associative manner. The first part, "Distant Voices", focuses on the father's role in the family. The second part, "Still Lives", focuses on his children.

Title: 199. Maniac Cop
description: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.

Title: 200. Spellbinder
description: A young lawyer, after falling in love with a beautiful woman, finds that she has an extremely mysterious past.

Title: 201. War Party
description: A group of re-enactors attempt to stage a hundred year anniversary battle between US Cavalry and Blackfeet Indians. Unfortunately racial hostilities and a real gun lead to some all too real casualties, and three young Blackfoot men are caught in the middle. The film follows their flight for freedom in the face of an angry community which has mistakenly blamed them for the violence.

Title: 202. Da
description: A New York playwright is summoned to Ireland to bury his father (his "Da"). While at his boyhood home, he encounters his father's spirit and relives memories both pleasant and not.

Title: 203. Spike of Bensonhurst
description: Italian kid with boxing dreams falls for mobster's daughter. Faces threats, relocates to impoverished Puerto Rican neighborhood.

Title: 204. Powaqqatsi
description: An exploration of technologically developing nations and the effect the transition to Western-style modernization has had on them.

Title: 205. Pound Puppies and the Legend of Big Paw
description: A magical artifact called the Bone of Scone gives "Puppy Power" to the animals. However, villain Marvin McNasty breaks it so humans lose the ability to understand animals. The Pound Puppies try to retrieve the Puppy Power.

Title: 206. Buster
description: Based on the story of Ronald Christopher "Buster" Edwards (Phil Collins), one of the thieves involved in "The Great Train Robbery" of 1963.

Title: 207. Thelonious Monk: Straight, No Chaser
description: A documentary film about the life of pianist and jazz great Thelonious Sphere Monk. Features live performances by Monk and his band, and interviews with friends and family about the offbeat genius.

Title: 208. Grave of the Fireflies
description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

Title: 209. The House on Carroll Street
description: In 1950s America, an FBI agent and a blacklist victim uncover a plot to smuggle Nazi war criminals into the country.

Title: 210. Full Moon in Blue Water
description: Floyd, the owner of a bar on the Texas coast, has been depressed for a year after his wife disappeared in a swimming accident. He lives with his senile father-in-law, and is helped by mentally challenged Jimmy, and the good-natured Louise.

Title: 211. Track 29
description: Linda is still tormented by giving up a baby for adoption at 15. She wants a baby, but her husband has enough in his model trains, mistress and being a doctor.

Title: 212. Drowning by Numbers
description: Three generations of women share the same problem--marriage woes--and want to put an end to it.

Title: 213. Tiger Warsaw
description: Chuck brought sorrow to his family when he shot his father who is now a semi-invalid. After 15 years of self destruction, he returns home to seek forgiveness.

Title: 214. Aloha Summer
description: It's the 60s and a bunch of crazy teenagers meet in the beautiful island of Hawaii during their summer holidays. Although they come from different backgrounds, they hang out together and shake up the island! They surf, dance, drink, fight and fall in love. As the summer approaches its end, they find themselves inseparable, friends for a lifetime...

Title: 215. Some Girls
description: Michael flies up to French Canada to visit his girlfriend and her wacky family. She doesn't love him anymore, the grandma mistakes him for her late husband, the sister appears naked and makes advances, the dad likes to be naked as well.

Title: 216. Space Mutiny
description: A pilot is the only hope to stop the mutiny of a spacecraft by its security crew, who plot to sell the crew of the ship into slavery.

Title: 217. The Decline of Western Civilization Part II: The Metal Years
description: Documentary showcase, what life was like for the music artists living during the Los Angeles Heavy Metal scene in the mid and late 1980s.

Title: 218. The Deceivers
description: Fact-based account of a secret society of murderers, and of the man who exposed them in British India 1825.

Title: 219. It Takes Two
description: A virgin 20-year-old small town guy is getting married to his childhood sweetheart. Anxious about the marriage, he goes to Dallas, Texas to buy a new car, but gets duped into buying a faulty supercar, and it all goes downhill from there.

Title: 220. Tapeheads
description: A couple of creative losers accidently become big shots in the video music industry.

Title: 221. Crusoe
description: Robinson Crusoe is shipwrecked and he finds himself all alone on a tropical island. With a few tools he manages to rescue from the wreck he has to learn to support himself until help arrives.

Title: 222. The Chocolate War
description: The Vigils are a gang of students at Trinity Catholic School... part of the tradition. They control the other boys by intimidation and the threat of violence.

Title: 223. Plain Clothes
description: To prove his brother's innocence, undercover officer Nick enrolls in high school again, dealing with crushes, bullies, humiliations, popularity swings, and quirky teachers and staff to find the real murderer.

Title: 224. Illegally Yours
description: A college dropout called for jury duty tries to prove his childhood crush innocent.

Title: 225. Call Me
description: A journalist agrees to meet an obscene caller at a bar and ends up witnessing a murder.

Title: 226. Paperhouse
description: A young girl lost in the loneliness and boredom of reality finds solace in an ill boy, whom she can visit in a surreal dream world that she drew in her school composition book.

Title: 227. Judgment in Berlin
description: American judge in Germany must decide if the hijacking of an East German plane into West Berlin was justified.

Title: 228. Mondo New York
description: The dark-side tour includes performance artists, a cockfight, a slave auction, someone biting a chicken's head off.

Title: 229. For Queen & Country
description: A retired British soldier struggles to adjust to everyday life, with increasing difficulty.

Title: 230. Miles from Home
description: Two brothers forced to leave their debt-ridden Midwest farm become folk heroes by robbing the banks that have been foreclosing on farmers.

Title: 231. Rocket Gibraltar
description: An aging patriarch unites all of his family members for his birthday, but the familial assemblage is teeming with personal and social problems.

Title: 232. Seven Hours to Judgment
description: A distraught husband kidnaps the judge who freed his wife's killers on insufficient evidence. He gives him seven hours to find evidence that will put them away, or he'll kill his wife.

Title: 233. The Blue Iguana
description: Two zealous IRS agents blackmail bounty hunter Vince Holloway into stopping an illegal transfer from a Mexican tax haven into the US. He arrives in Diablo, and has to assure himself the help of the bar owner Dakota and a teenage boy.

Title: 234. The Beast of War
description: A Soviet tank and its warring crew become separated from their patrol and lost in an Afghan valley with a group of vengeance-seeking rebels on their tracks.

Title: 235. Taffin
description: Mark Taffin (Pierce Brosnan), a rural Irish debt collector, protects locals including Charlotte while confronting corrupt officials Gibson and Henderson, whose land scheme threatens a community sports field and the town's future.

Title: 236. Distant Thunder
description: John Lithgow stars and Ralph Macchio co-stars as his son. Their uneasy reunion accidentally sparks war-haunted violence, and they share a harrowing fight for survival that will either destroy them or unify them forever.

Title: 237. Under the Boardwalk
description: Nick Rainwood and Allie Yorpin are a modern day Romeo and Juliet living in southern California, separated by the unbridgeable gulf of their backgrounds and torn between loyalty to their "gangs" and their real desires.

Title: 238. Hanna's War
description: Hanna Szenes, a Hungarian Jew living in British Palestine, volunteers to go behind enemy lines to rescue Jews from deportation to death camps.

Title: 239. The in Crowd
description: In the mid-60s, a teenage 4.0 high-school student is drawn out of his element on a dare by his peers, to become a dancer on popular TV music show.

Title: 240. Consuming Passions
description: A tragic mishap at a chocolate factory results in candy lovers getting an unexpected 'extra' in their sweets. The problem is that they want more!

Title: 241. The Telephone
description: A crazy out of work actress, Vashti Blue, spends all her time in her small apartment with her pet owl and her telephone, which she uses to try and solve all her problems with life.

Title: 242. Amsterdamned
description: A hard-boiled police detective sets out to capture a gruesome serial killer terrorizing the canals of Amsterdam.

Title: 243. Hanussen: Hitler's Astrologer
description: Hanussen is ultimately murdered by the Nazis in 1933-silenced once his truth becomes a threat.

Title: 244. Me and Him
description: A man's enthusiastic penis starts talking to him, getting him into awkward situations and convincing everyone he tells that he's completely insane.

Title: 245. Ghost Town
description: A modern-day deputy tracks an abducted girl to a ghost town, and the spirits of the past who took her.

Title: 246. Manifesto
description: In a small European country, the king is scheduled to visit a small, quiet and "safe" village. It turns out that while the village may indeed be small, it's neither as quiet nor as safe as it's expected to be.

Title: 247. Cohen and Tate
description: When a little boy witnesses a mob hit, he is kidnapped by two professional assassins who are not what they seem.

Title: 248. Pulse
description: A visiting son tries to warn his father and stepmother that they are being menaced by a living and intelligent pulse of electricity that moves from house to house and terrorizes the residents therein.

Title: 249. Tokyo Pop
description: Aspiring singer Wendy hops on a plane to Tokyo with dreams of making it big in the music business. She soon finds romance with Hiro, a rock 'n' roll musician who convinces her to become the lead singer in his band.

Title: 250. Let's Get Lost
description: Follows the life of jazz trumpeter and drug addict Chet Baker. Fascinating series of interviews with friends, family, associates and lovers, interspersed with film from Baker's earlier life and some modern-day performances.

Title: 251. Checking Out
description: A successful family man who works for an airline becomes consumed by fear of death after his colleague and best friend dies in front of him from a heart attack while telling the setup for the joke: "Why don't Italians like barbecues?"

Title: 252. Doin' Time on Planet Earth
description: Through a series of extraordinary circumstances, an eccentric teenager believes he may be the alien prince of a distant planet, ready to lead his brethren home.

Title: 253. Directed by Andrei Tarkovsky
description: Documentary on the making of "The Sacrifice."

Title: 254. We Think the World of You
description: Johnny goes to prison and leaves his dog Evie with his ex-lover and best friend Frank. Upon release, he faces troubles at home and may have to let Frank keep Evie.

Title: 255. Puss in Boots
description: Delightful tale of a cat who becomes a sharp gentleman and sets out to restore his master's name and wealth after he gives Puss a pair of magic boots.

Title: 256. Just Ask for Diamond
description: When the man who left a package in his care is murdered, detective Tim Diamond suddenly has every major gangster in the city after him. With only the package and the help of his little brother, he sets out to unravel the mysterious plot.

Title: 257. Haunted Summer
description: In 1816, authors Lord Byron, Mary Shelley and Percy Shelley get together for some philosophical discussions, but the situation soon deteriorates into mind games, drugs and sex.

Title: 258. As Tears Go By
description: Mid-level gangster Wah falls in love with his beautiful cousin, but must also continue to protect his volatile partner-in-crime and friend, Fly.

Title: 259. Mapantsula
description: Mapantsula tells the story of Panic, a petty gangster who inevitably becomes caught up in the growing anti-apartheid struggle and has to choose between individual gain and a united stand against the system.

Title: 260. Missing Link
description: A lone Australopithecine flees across Africa after humans kill his clan. He searches for his own kind through varied terrains to the coast, only to find humans there too.

Title: 261. The Prince of Pennsylvania
description: A teenager in love, who needs money to arrange his future life with his mistress, kidnaps his own father for ransom, but nobody cares.

Title: 262. After School
description: A student-teacher relationship goes way beyond the classroom, including pre-historic times.

Title: 263. Cheap Shots
description: The owner of a sleazy hotel, along with his friend, decides to videotape a room that is rented by a sexually active couple. Inadvertently recording their murders, the men are soon faced with a dilemma as the killers come looking for the tape.

Title: 264. State Park
description: A business man plans to dump toxic waste in a state park, but it doesn't go according to plan.

Title: 265. The Vanishing
description: Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.

Title: 266. Killer Klowns from Outer Space
description: Aliens who look like clowns come from outer space and terrorize a small town.

Title: 267. Man Behind the Sun
description: Japanese troops round up Chinese and Russian prisoners of war and take them to unit 731, where they're horribly tortured and experimented on to test new biological weapons.

Title: 268. On the Silver Globe
description: A team of astronauts land on an inhabitable planet and form a society. Many years later, a single astronaut is sent to the planet and becomes a messiah.

Title: 269. A Short Film About Love
description: A naive inexperienced young man spies on a woman who lives across the courtyard, and falls in love with her. He starts using tricks which he hopes will lead to them meeting.

Title: 270. Landscape in the Mist
description: Two children journey the long road to Germany to find the man they believe to be their father.

Title: 271. Alice
description: A surrealistic revision of Alice in Wonderland.

Title: 272. Brain Damage
description: One morning, a young man wakes to find that a small, disgusting creature has attached itself to the base of his brain stem. The creature gives him a euphoric state of happiness but demands human victims in return.

Title: 273. Damnation
description: A lonely barfly falls in love with a married bar singer.

Title: 274. Time of the Gypsies
description: In this luminous tale set in the area around Sarajevo and in Italy, Perhan, an engaging young Romany (gypsy) with telekinetic powers, is seduced by the quick-cash world of petty crime, which threatens to destroy him and those he loves.

Title: 275. Nekromantik
description: A street sweeper who cleans up after grisly accidents brings home a full corpse for him and his wife to enjoy sexually, but is dismayed to see that his wife prefers the corpse over him.

Title: 276. A Short Film About Killing
description: A soon-to-be lawyer crosses his path with a taxi driver and a young sinister man.

Title: 277. Pin
description: Isolated by his strange parents, Leon finds solace in an imaginary friend, which happens to be an anatomy doll from his father's doctor office. Unfortunately, the doll begins to take over Leon's life, and his sister's life as well.

Title: 278. Police Story 2
description: The Hong Kong supercop must stop a group of blackmailing bombers, while the villains of Police Story (1985) are out for revenge.

Title: 279. Doraemon: The Record of Nobita's Parallel Visit to the West
description: Nobita and his friends go an adventure to save the future from monsters that come out from doraemon's gadget.Will nobita be able to capture all of them and help a monk in his journey to the west?

Title: 280. Hell Comes to Frogtown
description: After a worldwide nuclear war, where 68% of the male population was wiped out and virile men becoming a rarity, Sam Hell, a scavenger and a highly virile man, is assigned to help rescue a group of fertile women kidnapped by humanoid frogs.

Title: 281. Not of This Earth
description: An alien arrives on Earth looking to take human blood in an attempt to preserve his dying planet.

Title: 282. Evil Dead Trap
description: A late night TV presenter receives a snuff tape, in which a woman is brutally killed. She decides to take a crew out to a location indicated in the tape, but only death and despair await them.

Title: 283. Virgin
description: A night in the life of a young woman who wishes to learn and experience more of life. The men she meets have as much to learn from her as they can offer her, or more.

Title: 284. Scarecrows
description: Bank robbers parachute from a hijacked plane into a field full of killer scarecrows.

Title: 285. Blue Movies
description: Ambitious friends turn their apartment into a makeshift film studio, learning hard lessons about the adult entertainment business.

Title: 286. Death Spa
description: Lightning strikes a neon health club sign, turning a high-tech temple of fitness into a mechanized deathtrap for its glamorous clientele.

Title: 287. The Night Before
description: A popular beauty surprisingly asks a nerd to take her to the prom. He wakes up hours later in a sleazy alley. She's missing but he remembers nothing about it.

Title: 288. The Cellar
description: A family moves into an old house in the Texas desert that is haunted by a Native American curse in the form of a ferocious creature that dwells underground.

Title: 289. Salome's Last Dance
description: On Guy Fawkes Day 1892 Oscar Wilde goes to a performance of his controversial, banned play 'Salome'. The 'theatre' is a brothel and the performers are prostitutes.

Title: 290. Red Sorghum
description: When a leprous winery owner in 1930s China dies a few days after his arranged marriage, his young widow is forced to run the winery to make a living while contending with bandits, her drunkard lover, and the invading Japanese army.

Title: 291. Witchcraft
description: Grace visits husband John's family manor. Peculiar events ensue. Ellsworth, the butler, is suspicious. A friend's demise reveals John and her mother-in-law are 1687 witches. Grace and baby's fate unclear amid supernatural occurrences.

Title: 292. Rowing with the Wind
description: Lord Byron, poet Percy Shelley, his future wife, Mary Shelley (writing Frankenstein) and others spend the summer of 1816 together.

Title: 293. Slugs
description: Killer slugs on the rampage in a rural community.

Title: 294. Demonwarp
description: Bill Crafton and his daughter Julie are attacked in the woods by what they believe is a Bigfoot-type creature. However, they soon begin to suspect that they may have stumbled onto a nest of aliens in a hidden spacecraft.

Title: 295. The Dark Side of the Sun
description: A man finds freedom and love as he travels in search of a cure for a rare skin disease.

Title: 296. Dragons Forever
description: Three successful Hong Kong lawyers are hired by a chemical company of questionable ethics and must eventually make a difficult decision when their employer's motives become clear.

Title: 297. The Siege of Firebase Gloria
description: A tough U.S. sergeant and his sidekick roll into a demoralized firebase, where they attempt to rebuild morale and fortifications amid a climactic battle with the Viet Cong.

Title: 298. Story of Women
description: A housewife in Nazi-occupied France struggles to make ends meet when her husband returns home after being wounded in the war.

Title: 299. Transformations
description: Wolfgang is traveling in outer space when a monster, which he sees as a beautiful woman, appears in his spaceship and makes love with him. Then the ship is forced to land on a planet which is a penal colony. Here he meets Miranda who falls in love with him. A group of prisoners uses him and his spaceship to fly away from the planet. But the monster which is by now inside Wolfgang arouses and only Miranda's love can save him.

Title: 300. Primal Rage
description: A scientist at a Florida University accidentally creates a "rage virus" while conducting experiments to restore dead brain tissue in baboons. The virus soon spreads.

Title: 301. Vampire in Venice
description: Professor Paris Catalano visits Venice, to investigate the last known appearance of the famous vampire Nosferatu during the carnival of 1786.

Title: 302. Too Beautiful to Die
description: The models of an agency are invited to a party by the owner of the agency. During the party, one of the models gets raped by a powerful guest, with help from the other models. Soon, the models start to get killed one by one.

Title: 303. Grandmother's House
description: After the death of their beloved father, two teens go to their grandmother's house in California and begin to suspect their grandparents of murder.

Title: 304. Moonwalker
description: Anthology movie by, and starring, Michael Jackson in his prime, combining a number of music videos from his bestselling "Bad" album with a fantasy tale of Michael's confrontation with a ruthless drug dealer known as Mr. Big.

Title: 305. Life Is a Long Quiet River
description: A revengeful nurse switches a girl and a boy at birth. They are raised in two radically different families. When the switch is revealed many years later, the now teenagers and families need to cope with their new environments.

Title: 306. Edge of the Axe
description: An axe murderer terrorizes a small Northern California mountain community, while two young computer-obsessed adults attempt to solve the killings.

Title: 307. Tiger on the Beat
description: A seasoned cop and his rookie partner are a pair of mismatched partners in this Hong Kong action-comedy in the style of 'Lethal Weapon'. The wacky twosome are up in arms as they try to solve the murder of a heroin trafficker.

Title: 308. Daffy Duck's Quackbusters
description: Daffy Duck opens a detective agency for the supernatural alongside his Looney Toon buddies.

Title: 309. Zerograd
description: Going on a business trip, the hero of the film suddenly finds himself in a fantastic city. It is very similar to our world, only the hidden absurdity of everyday life here has become apparent.

Title: 310. Ariel
description: A Finnish man goes to the city to find a job after the mine where he worked is closed and his father commits suicide.

Title: 311. The Legend of the Holy Drinker
description: An alcoholic homeless man is given two hundred francs by a stranger, who requests that when he can he will return the money to Saint Therese in the cathedral.

Title: 312. Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
description: A sex-changed slasher returns as a camp counselor.

Title: 313. Lemon Sky
description: An out of high school teen from the midwest moves to San Diego, California in the 1950s to live with his estranged father and new family. Escaping his past may not be as easy as he had hoped...or is it all a dream?

Title: 314. Tiger Cage
description: After busting a drug ring, and later killing the gang leader, a cop begins to suspect a senior colleague of being involved in drug trafficking with Americans. He starts to gather evidence, oblivious to the fact the corruption runs deep.

Title: 315. Deadbeat at Dawn
description: One last job separates the leader of the Ravens gang from an early retirement. When he finds his girlfriend beaten to death by members of a rival gang, he seeks revenge, knowing that he may be dead by dawn. Will more blood bring her back?

Title: 316. The Rejuvenator
description: Aging actress hires scientist developing youth serum involving brain fluid extraction. She takes it, but unintended consequences transform her into a homicidal creature.

Title: 317. King Size
description: This comedy follows a young scientist in the contemporary world, who actually came from the world of dwarves, thanks to a magic potion, held by the Big Eater, ruler of the dwarves. The dwarf kingdom, Shuflandia, exists in a cellar of a library, and only the most obedient get the chance to grow to king size and inhabit the larger world. Once there, nobody wants to return to Shuflandia. Also, there are no women in Shuflandia.

Title: 318. The Visitors
description: A family's dream home in the countryside becomes a nightmare when unexplained events plague their lives. After a paranormal investigator dies during his research, the father must uncover the dark secrets hidden in the attic.

Title: 319. Summer Vacation 1999
description: Summer vacation has emptied a Japanese boys' school of all but three boys: the junior Norio & the seniors Kazuhiko & Naoto. They have no families to return to for the summer, so they spend their days in the empty school. A darkness hangs over the three however: the suicide, three months earlier, of classmate Yu. Norio blames Kazuhiko for Yu's death, because it was well-known that Yu loved Kazuhiko; so Kazuhiko is cruel to Norio, and yet has bad dreams. This uneasy arrangement is exacerbated by the arrival of Kaoru, a student early for the fall - who looks exactly like Yu.

Title: 320. The Teacher
description: Husnu has got issues and inabilities about the complex and expensive metropolitan life who was a successful teacher in his little town and got a promotion and appointment to Istanbul.

Title: 321. Espérame en el cielo
description: Did Franco have a double? The story is set in the late 40's, in Spain... The humble owner of an orthopedics shop in Madrid is abducted by a misterious group... He disappears for the external world... What happened to him? Due to an uncanny similarity with the dictator, Franco, he has been "selected" for the highly secret "Operation Janus", to provide a double for Franco for dangerous moments.

Title: 322. Chithram
description: A woman hires a stranger to pose as her husband because she doesn't want her ailing father to know that her fiance broke their engagement.

Title: 323. Cheerleader Camp
description: A group of cheerleaders become the targets of an unknown killer at a remote summer camp.

Title: 324. Return of the Killer Tomatoes!
description: Crazy old Professor Gangreen has developed a way to make tomatoes look human for a second invasion.

Title: 325. Prime Evil
description: A coven of devil-worshiping monks living in New York City search for victims for their sacrificial ceremonies.

Title: 326. Jack's Back
description: A serial killer in Los Angeles celebrates Jack the Ripper's 100th birthday by committing similar murders.

Title: 327. Moontrap
description: NASA finds remains of an ancient humanoid race on the Moon that left behind deadly robots.

Title: 328. Phoenix the Warrior
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, women warriors battle each other from junkyards to gravel pits as they determine the fate of the entire world.

Title: 329. Veerana
description: A beautiful young girl, unfortunately possessed from her childhood by a vengeful spirit, wanders around lonely places to seduce and kill people, gradually becoming lost into a dark world of revenge and lust.

Title: 330. The Student
description: Weeks from her final exams, part-time teacher Valentine meets a very different musician. Just a one-night stand and back to preparing for exams, she thinks.

Title: 331. Picasso Trigger
description: When a vengeful crime lord targets top-secret agents following the Paris assassination of double agent Picasso Trigger, a team of lethal operatives must survive a global gauntlet of explosive traps to bring down his syndicate.

Title: 332. Emmanuelle 6
description: 5 models board a cruise ship with a cute Indian stowaway in Emmanuelle's trunk. A 2nd officer plans a kidnap of them with jewels once they reach the Amazon jungle.

Title: 333. Re-Wind
description: After a snuff video is found in a sex booth, a young man and a female reporter both find themselves obsessed with discovering its origin.

Title: 334. Snack Bar Budapest
description: While his girlfriend recovers from a medical procedure, a corrupt lawyer becomes entranced by the grand visions of a mob boss.

Title: 335. Doom Asylum
description: A horribly disfigured lawyer, wrongfully pronounced dead after a terrible car accident, is taken to an asylum for dissection, only to come back alive, kill everyone, and make the asylum his killing grounds.

Title: 336. Black Eagle
description: A CIA agent must outrace a KGB agent as they both search for a super weapon lost in the Mediterranean.

Title: 337. Miami Connection
description: A martial arts rock band goes up against a band of motorcycle ninjas who have tightened their grip on Florida's narcotics trade.

Title: 338. The Girl Next Door
description: Middle-aged married journalist goes to the beach resort of Búzios, in Brazil, to write a book. Gradually, he falls in love with his neighbor's daughter, a beautiful teenager much younger than he, ignoring the social implications.

Title: 339. Iron Angels II
description: After a successful mission, the Angels decide to spend a vacation in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and connect with one of Alex's schooldays friends, who's now a successful businessman and a millionaire. But the friend hides a deadly secret.

Title: 340. Top Model
description: Sarah, a writer researching prostitution, starts an escort service with Dorothy. An unhappy client blackmails Sarah. Cliff, a shy programmer hired to help, falls for Sarah. They overcome obstacles and threats to be together, leaving town.

Title: 341. Oru CBI Diary Kurippu
description: Prabhakara Varma is called upon to investigate the death of Omana, the daughter-in-law of a local businessman. It looks like a suicide but, Varma is sure that is not so.

Title: 342. Purple People Eater
description: A kid plays the old novelty song "Purple People Eater" and the creature actually appears. The two then proceed to help an elderly couple who are being evicted by their greedy landlord.

Title: 343. The Further Adventures of Tennessee Buck
description: A broke, alcoholic guide leads a rich couple on a jungle hunting trip, but grows suspicious of their true motives as the expedition progresses.

Title: 344. Heart of Midnight
description: Carol inherits her uncle's night club, discovering his strangeness while confronting memories of their special relationship as she adapts to her new life.

Title: 345. Gor II
description: An Earthman returns to the planet Gor, and fights against tyranny.

Title: 346. The Brain
description: A psychologist with an increasingly popular TV show brainwashes his audiences using a giant living brain. A mischievous high school student is sent to the psychologist's institute, and becomes determined to expose him.

Title: 347. Angel III: The Final Chapter
description: Molly accidentally takes a picture of a woman who turns out to be her mother, who abandoned her 14 years ago. She tracks her down, only to find that she has another daughter, and both are connected to a dangerous crime element.

Title: 348. Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak
description: Despite knowing that their respective families are bitter enemies, Raj and Rashmi fall in love with each other and decide to elope.

Title: 349. The Spider Labyrinth
description: Alan Whitmore, a young American researcher, is sent to Budapest to check in on Professor Roth, with whom he's collaborating on a secret research project called 'Intextus'. Once there, he finds himself surrounded by a malevolent presence.

Title: 350. The Boy from Hell
description: A teenage boy is hidden at an orphanage by his mother to protect him against his father, who wants to use the boys body to be reborn.

Title: 351. Hide and Go Shriek
description: A group of teenagers spend the night in a furniture store for a graduation party. A psycho killer starts hunting them down one by one.

Title: 352. Alien from L.A.
description: A young woman travels to Africa looking for her missing archaeologist father and stumbles into a strange subterranean civilization.

Title: 353. Deathstalker and the Warriors from Hell
description: The third thrilling saga of Deathstalker pits him against the evil wizard and ruler of the Southland, Troxartes, and his band of undead warriors.

Title: 354. Hobgoblins
description: A young security guard must track down diminutive aliens who kill people even as they make their fantasies come true.

Title: 355. Zombie 3
description: When a terrorist's body, infected with a stolen chemical, is cremated by the US military, a virus is unintentionally released into the atmosphere over a small island.

Title: 356. The Green Inferno
description: Four friends head into the jungle to locate a lost professor but instead face off against treasure hunters who are torturing and killing natives.

Title: 357. Black Roses
description: Demons hypnotize the general public by posing as a rock and roll band.

Title: 358. Ghosthouse
description: Visions of a deceased girl and her doll bring doom to the visitors of a deserted house.

Title: 359. School on Fire
description: A young schoolgirl gets involved in the triads of Hong Kong after a classmate is killed in a fight.

Title: 360. Chillers
description: Five passengers in a bus depot are waiting for a bus that is overdue. To pass the time, they start telling each other horror stories.

Title: 361. The Unnamable
description: College students check out a haunted house where in the 1800s an ugly monster called "the Unnamable" was trapped in a vault.

Title: 362. Last Rites
description: Angela, the beautiful Mexican mistress of a NY mobster, asks virginal Father Michael for protection after Zena, the mobster's wife, kills her cheating husband. Michael becomes torn between his vows, Angela and his sister - Zena.

Title: 363. Patti Rocks
description: It's Christmas time in the twin cities. Billy's working a lot of overtime, running barges on the Mississippi. He calls his friend Eddie, whom he hasn't seen in six months, and asks a favor: to drive with him to see his pregnant girlfriend, Patti, because Billy hasn't told her he's married and already has two children. The road trip of guy talk becomes a night of truths exchanged between men and women.

Title: 364. The Sisterhood
description: In the year 2021, women have been enslaved by men, with their only hope for freedom lying in the hands of a nomadic band of maiden warriors. The maiden warriors Alee and Vera tap Marya and her hawk to help them.

Title: 365. Rabid Grannies
description: Two sweet little old ladies fall victim to an ancient curse that transforms them into bloodthirsty killers!

Title: 366. Commuters
description: A 13-year-old boy juggling family duties catches a glimpse of a girl on his daily train commute. Despite his overwhelming responsibilities at home, he becomes determined to make her fall for him.

Title: 367. Warlords
description: Dow is an ex-soldier searching the wasteland for his wife who was taken from him by the Warlord. With only a disembodied, wisecracking head and a renegade woman named Danny as his companions, they roam the terrain to try and get back the woman that Dow lost.

Title: 368. Summer Temptations
description: Young widow Vanessa lives with stepdaughters Kikki and Vivi on island villa. She invites former lover Roberto, now professor, to tutor girls. Tensions arise between Vanessa, stepdaughters, and Roberto in isolated luxury setting.

Title: 369. Homeboy
description: A simple self-destructive drifter and tough small-time boxer with a brain injury that could kill him meets and falls for a cute beach carnival owner, Ruby, but also befriends a sleazy friendly criminal, Wesley, who's planning a big score.

Title: 370. Door
description: After several strangely threatening calls from a local salesman, a homemaker becomes increasingly afraid to answer her apartment door.

Title: 371. Gangaa Jamunaa Saraswathi
description: In a small town, Gangaa and Jamunaa's budding romance faces obstacles from Hansraj, who harbors dark intentions. Meanwhile, Saraswathi silently pines for Gangaa, as another suitor, Shanker, hopes to win Jamunaa's heart.

Title: 372. The Cat
description: Two bank robbers hold the clerks hostage and demand 3 million German marks as ransom. What the police do not realise is that the true criminal mastermind watches them from outside the bank, anticipating every move.

Title: 373. Macho Dancer
description: Pol, a mountain teen, goes to Manila to support his family and, guided by a call-boy mentor, is drawn into a dangerous world of sex work, drugs, and police corruption.

Title: 374. Robowar
description: A special forces unit known as BAM is tasked with a mission: tracking down the rogue Omega-1 cyborg unit in a dense jungle, without being told their exact objective. Soon they find themselves the hunted rather than the hunters.

Title: 375. Tezaab
description: After his parents are killed, Mahesh's life is ruined as he gets imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers due to her cruel father. Mahesh returns to save Mohini and settle old scores.

Title: 376. Biwi Ho To Aisi
description: Family drama that revolves around the lead pair, a married couple played by Rekha and Farooq Shaikh. It's about how the character Shalu overcomes all of the obstacles in her married life to win over the acceptance of her domineering mother-in-law Kamla.

Title: 377. Kung-Fu Master!
description: Mary-Jane, a lonely mother in her forties, gets absorbed in a sentimental affair with a 14-year-old boy.

Title: 378. Deep Space
description: A spaceship with a hideous monster with an incredible appetite for flesh crashes to Earth. Unsuspecting policemen Ian Mclemore and Jerry Merris investigate the wreckage. They discover several small pods, which they remove.

Title: 379. Intimacy
description: Softcore film about the love triangle between a young model/waitress, her boyfriend and her sadomadochistic lover.

Title: 380. Her Vengeance
description: A woman seeks revenge against her attackers.

Title: 381. Woman in the Moon
description: Angela returns to Sicily for her father's funeral. On the ferry, she meets Salvo, a teen who says the Mafia's after him for stealing drugs. She offers him a ride, starting a journey where his romantic interest becomes clear.

Title: 382. Faceless
description: When model Barbara Hallen disappears in France, her father's private detective traces her steps to a private plastic surgery clinic run by Dr.Flamand.

Title: 383. Blood Delirium
description: After the death of his beloved wife, an unbalanced painter, who believes he is the reincarnation of Vincent Van Gogh, freaks out and digs up her corpse - with the help of his necrophilic butler - to bring her back.

Title: 384. Crime Zone
description: In a repressive futuristic dystopian society, a young man, just laid-off from his security job, falls in love with a prostitute. A mysterious man hires them to do a heist, and claims that he can smuggle them out to a neighboring country.

Title: 385. The Wizard of Speed and Time
description: A filmmaker creates a short for a devious studio while its producer secretly bets $25,000 against the film's usefulness. His friends step in to help.

Title: 386. Pledge Night
description: A college fraternity in the middle of hazing their new pledges during "hell week" incur the wrath of a long deceased pledge who died during a hazing gone wrong 20 years ago.

Title: 387. Party Line
description: A rich brother and sister are crazed killers. She lures men into her bed, and he attacks them and murders them. A detective is assigned to find the killers and bring them in.

Title: 388. Shahenshah
description: Vijay who is a corrupt officer by day, turns a vigilante by night in order to make the city crime free.

Title: 389. Stars and Bars
description: A British art expert travels across America in order to purchase a rare Renoir painting in the South but comes across some crazy characters in the process.

Title: 390. Hollow Gate
description: At a Halloween party, a young boy is almost killed by his drunken, alcoholic father. Ten years afterward, the boy goes on a murder spree.

Title: 391. The Shadowed Mind
description: Stephanie arrives as a patient at a private clinic for sufferers of sexual dysfunction run by Dr Hildesheimer. Stephanie's fellow patients all have their own issues including inhibition, neurosis, fixation, delusions and more. Stephanie begins a tentative affair with one of the other patients while a killer stalks the institution.

Title: 393. Burning Secret
description: An American diplomat's lonely 12-year-old son is infatuated by a suave baron. Soon his friend heartlessly turns his seductive attentions to his mother. The boy's jealousy and feelings of betrayal become uncontrollable.

Title: 394. Dream Demon
description: A young woman about to be married begins having terrifying dreams about demons. When she wakes, however, the demons are real and begin to commit gruesome murders.

Title: 395. To Die For
description: Los Angeles realtor Kate Wooten's life changes when enigmatic client Vlad hires her to find an isolated castle, leading her into unexpected circumstances revolving around Vlad's true nature and desires.

Title: 396. Sound and Fury
description: Bruno is 14. When his grandmother dies, he returns to Bagnolet with his mother who is rarely there. At school he meets Jean-Roger, who introduces him to a group of delinquents.

Title: 397. The 13th Floor
description: As a child, a girl witnesses her father electrocute a young boy. When she grows into an adult, the ghost of the murdered boy appears to her, and together they set out to expose the crimes of her father.

Title: 398. Neatmenu tavo veido
description: Story about teenage love in sanatorium. Leta, a girl with a heart disease, and Saulius, a new boy in sanatorium, fall in love with each other, but doctors try to forbid young people feelings.

Title: 399. The Needle
description: Moro returns to Alma Ata to collect money owed to him. While waiting out an unexpected delay, he visits his former girlfriend Dina, and discovers she has become a morphine addict. He decides to help her kick the habit and to fight the local drug mafia responsible for her condition. But Moro finds a deadly opponent in "the doctor," the mafia kingpin who is exploiting Dina.

Title: 400. Shame
description: A barrister visiting a town in Western Australian town battles police corruption and the silence of the locals to help a teenage girl seek justice against a gang of young rapists.

Title: 401. Top Line
description: Author Ted Angelo discovers a U.F.O. in the Colombian jungle. When he tries to spread the word, he earns more than the usual disbelief. Suddenly he's hunted by almost every organization, like the C.I.A., the K.G.B., the mob, Nazis, and even extra-terrestrials. Those E.T.s obviously do not want to phone home.

Title: 402. Destroyer
description: A prison riot breaks out at the moment of serial killer Ivan Moser's electrocution, after which Moser is not found. 18 months later, director Robert Edwards and company arrive to film an exploitation film titled Death House Dollies.

Title: 403. Dirty Love
description: Valentine Demy and Susan Little star in this erotic tale of a young girl who sets off from the suburbs of New York City to seek fame as a dancer on Broadway. She finds that her exuberant body brings her into contact with many different facets of the Broadway nightlife, with sex as the dominant factor.

Title: 404. Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack
description: Amuro Ray and Char Aznable settle their rivalry once and for all during the Second Neo Zeon War.

Title: 405. Apprentice to Murder
description: The small beautiful Pennsylvania Dutch community is rocked by a series of bizarre events which lead to a web of deception, violence and murder. Apprentice to Murder is a story of infatuation with love, dreams, and out-of-world temptations.

Title: 406. Dogra Magra
description: A young man kills his bride on the day of his marriage and goes insane. He wakes up in an asylum with no memory, left in the hands of two mysterious doctors who relate his condition with his biological identity.

Title: 407. A Few Days with Me
description: Martial befriends a supermarket manager, becomes involved with Francine, then sacrifices himself by taking responsibility for a killing to save her boyfriend, after which Francine and Fernand part.

Title: 408. Out of the Dark
description: Beautiful young women who work at the offices of a phone-sex company are being stalked by a psychopathic killer.

Title: 409. Troma's War
description: A group of assorted Americans survive a plane crash in a Caribbean island, and discover it is infested with crawling snakes and other venomous beasts. Even worse, terrorists are preparing a full out war on America with a biological weapon.

Title: 410. A Summer Story
description: Frank Ashton and his best friend are hiking across Dartmoor when he twists his ankle. Frank goes for help at a nearby farmhouse where he stays for a few days and falls in love with Megan.

Title: 411. Hawks
description: Two terminally ill patients in a hospital yearn for relief from their predicament. With little or no friends, they form an uneasy alliance and plot an escape for one last wild time.

Title: 413. FleshEater
description: A group of college students on an overnite hayride come across a group of maneating zombies. They must fight for their lives while trying to escape and warn the authorities.

Title: 414. Flesh-Eating Mothers
description: Suburban housewives turn into vicious cannibals after committing adultery with the neighborhood womanizer.

Title: 415. Tommy Tricker and the Stamp Traveller
description: Tommy Tricker cons Ralph James out of a valuable stamp, setting off magical events. Ralph and his sister Nancy shrink down and travel on stamps, reaching Australia where rare stamps become part of their adventure.

Title: 416. Los gatos de las azoteas
description: There are people disappearing in an apartment building and a psychopath killer is doing it. A man is busy cheating on his wife, another man is looking for love in the same building. It's up to Los Gatos to stop the sexy madness.

Title: 417. Remote Control
description: Aliens are trying to take over Earth using a supposed 1957 sci-fi movie to mind control Earthlings into killing each other. Can 2 video store clerks prevent this?

Title: 418. Blood Relations
description: Thomas takes his beautiful girlfriend to meet his crazy surgeon father at a remote mansion. Things get out of control, ending with a twist that will make you love this horror movie.

Title: 419. Born to Defense
description: Jet, a young soldier at the end of the second World War must overcome some abusive Americans who are bullying him as well as the Chinese people.

Title: 420. El Dorado
description: A group of Spanish explorers embarks on a perilous journey across uncharted waters in search of El Dorado, a mythical city of untold riches, during the age of conquest.

Title: 421. Top Squad
description: After an incident involving an Arab sheikh's wife, the Hong Kong police decide to create a female squad, with officer Wu in charge of training the new recruits. Soon, they will have to prove themselves in the line of duty.

Title: 422. Santet
description: After poisoning his wife, a local gangster blames the village priest for her death and incites an outraged crowd to set fire to his cabin.

Title: 423. Nightmare at Noon
description: Scientists poison the water supply of a small town, turning the residents into homicidal maniacs who kill each other and anybody who passes through.

Title: 424. Far North
description: After generations of being apart, an accident brings a family back together and they begin to cope with their original issues.

Title: 425. Felix the Cat: The Movie
description: In another dimension, the villainous scientist Duke of Zill, with the help of his mechanical, geometric army, takes over the Land of Oriana, prompting Felix the Cat to save its princess and restore order once again.

Title: 426. Paganini Horror
description: When a female rock band uses an infamous old piece of sheet music to record their new album in an old mansion, they accidentally open a portal to hell.

Title: 427. Jane B. for Agnes V.
description: The film is a portrait-in-cinema where we discover Jane Birkin in all her facets, in every state, and across different seasons - herself in all her diversity.

Title: 428. The Invisible Kid
description: A nerdy teenage scientist discovers a formula for invisibility, and uses it to take revenge on all those who have wronged him--and also to spy on the girls' shower room.

Title: 429. Straight for the Heart
description: A war photographer returns home to Montréal to discover that his two partners have left him to be together. Alone in the city, he photographs what he sees, trying to heal both his war memories and a broken heart.

Title: 430. Legend of the Galactic Heroes: My Conquest is the Sea of Stars
description: Two interstellar armies continue their 150-year-long war. On both sides, mid-ranking soldiers question the judgment of their superior officers and worry about the future.

Title: 431. BraveStarr: The Legend
description: Marshal Bravestarr and a female judge are sent to New Texas, a frontier planet under attack by the evil cattle spirit Stampede, who, with his ruthless sidekick, Tex Hex, are vying for control of the universe, one planet at a time.

Title: 432. Strike of the Panther
description: Martial artist and cop Jason Blade must venture into a volatile chemical plant to bring down his archenemy Jim Baxter and save his girlfriend.

Title: 433. Dangerous Love
description: Someone is videotaping and killing members of a video dating club.

Title: 434. Rat Man
description: A fashion model is murdered on a Caribbean island, and her sister investigates with her friend Fred, uncovering a horrifying rat-like creature which Fred kills, but the true horror is just beginning.

Title: 435. On the Run
description: Hsiang Ming's wife is murdered, prompting him to seek her killer. Unexpectedly, the culprit isn't as he imagined, with unforeseen enemies now targeting him.

Title: 436. Assault of the Killer Bimbos
description: Two go-go dancers, Lulu and Peaches, are framed for the murder of their employer by the real killer, sleazy gangster Vinnie. Picking up waitress Darlene along the way, the three are involved in wild car chases with cops as they head south to cross the border into Mexico, where they unexpectedly encounter Vinnie in a fleabag Mexican motel.

Title: 437. Blades
description: Somewhere in New Jersey, a killer lawnmower stalks a small town's golf course.

Title: 438. The Witches' Sabbath
description: A psychiatrist evaluates a woman who claims to be a 17th-century witch, and becomes drawn into a spiral where reality and hallucination blur.

Title: 439. Reflections of Light
description: After a car incident, in which he lost his wife, a musician remains paralytic. He retire in a lonely villa together with a bisexual, a lesbian and a vicious kid.

Title: 440. Om Dar-B-Dar
description: A carefully constructed nonsense about a teenage boy named Om in a small Indian village.

Title: 441. Tabu
description: A widow and her teenage daughter run a farm with help from their handsome neighbor. As both women develop feelings for him, their peaceful rural life transforms into a complex web of desires and rivalries.

Title: 442. Journey to the Center of the Earth
description: Young people exploring a cave in Hawaii fall into a hole, and wind up in the lost city of Atlantis.

Title: 443. Zombie 5: Killing Birds
description: A group of college students go into the woods to study birds. They encounter a strange blind man who's connected to the killer zombies that prowl a dilapidated house deep in the forest.

Title: 444. The Undertaker
description: A deranged undertaker kills various people to keep as his friends in his seedy funeral home.

Title: 445. Cameron's Closet
description: A father (Tab Hunter) who experiments with his son's (Scott Curtis) psychokinetic powers is unaware that these experiments release a demon from hell, which lives in his son's closet, preparing to take over the young boy's soul.

Title: 446. You Can't Hurry Love
description: A comedy of a guy who is told the only way to be successful in LA is by "pretending to be someone else." Through a series of dates at a video dating service, he learns that isn't the case, and that it's better to be yourself, rather than what you think others want you to be. Based on the comedy short film "Video Valentino."

Title: 447. The Venus Trap
description: Max, a Berlin doctor, falls for a mysterious woman's voice after accidentally calling her. He meets Marie, and they fall in love while trying to bring their partners, Coco and Kurt, together.

Title: 448. Itinerary of a Spoiled Child
description: A successful entrepreneur in his fifties decides to abandon his loved ones and the empire he has built to find the liberty he yearns for, unaware that the itinerary of one's life often changes in the funniest of ways.

Title: 449. Higher Education
description: Another Canadian screwball comedy involving a horny college man who can't decide between his girlfriend and his teacher.

Title: 450. Beach Balls
description: Charlie Harrison dreams of being a rock star and, with the help of friends and a gang of local toughs, he arranges a concert in his house for a big time record producer or at least that is what Charlie thought he was arranging.

Title: 451. It's Impossible to Learn to Plow by Reading Books
description: A young man travels around the country, meeting acquaintances and strangers alike. Through these encounters, Richard Linklater offers a glimpse of the humanity found in the everyday.

Title: 452. Ödipussi
description: Gray-haired furniture retailer Paul Winkelmann still has his dinner cooked and his laundry done by his mother. He spends his evenings playing Scrabble with Mama's friends and discussing the role of women in society in his carnival club. When he meets psychologist Margarete Tietze, "Pussi" finally begins to rebel against his dominant mother.

Title: 453. La Travestie
description: An emotionally and professionally frustrated young woman decides to pose as a man in order to gain control of her life.

Title: 454. Domino
description: A girl in the video industry travels with a jeweled turtle and makes Billie Holliday videos. Though having relations with some of her friends, she is looking for love. She begins getting calls from a stranger who tells her not to worry, that he'll watch over her. But when she wants to meet him he does not show up.

Title: 455. Memorial Valley Massacre
description: Arriving at the newly opened Memorial Valley Park on its maiden weekend, the first group of campers are terrorized by a primitive young hermit who begins killing campers in order to defend what he considers to be his territory.

Title: 456. Dixie Lanes
description: A small-town Southern family may have survived World War II, but will they survive a family reunion?

Title: 457. Ashik Kerib
description: A talented but poor minstrel is forced to wander throughout the world because of impossibility to be with his true love - a rich merchant's daughter.

Title: 458. The Big Heat
description: Inspector Waipong Wong must put his life on hold and postpone his resignation from the Hong Kong police department to investigate the mysterious murder of his former partner.

Title: 459. The Carpenter
description: A mentally unstable woman and her husband hire men to fix up their new house. A mysterious carpenter becomes her guardian angel, but he is actually a dead serial killer whose spirit has returned to finish the dream house he once started.

Title: 460. Purgatory
description: Two Peace Corps volunteers in Africa are framed and put into an oppressive women's prison.

Title: 461. Dangerous Curves
description: A college graduate is offered a deal of a lifetime - deliver a Porsche for a client and join the company of your dreams in return. When the car gets stolen, he and his friend must go to a beauty pageant run by the thief to get it back.

Title: 462. Catacombs
description: A demon is trapped in a monastery. 400 years later a young girl arrives at the monastery to study.

Title: 463. Ashi Hi Banwa Banwi
description: Four friends are searching for rented accommodation. The landlady insists only on married couples, so two of the friends are forced to dress as women and pretend to be wives of the other two.

Title: 464. Killing American Style
description: A gang of hot-headed brutes led by Tony Stone embark on a killing spree that only American good guy John Morgan can stop.

Title: 465. Slime City
description: A student moves into a run-down building in New York City. His bizarre neighbors make a concoction in their apartment they call wine, but when he takes some of it, he turns into a deformed, murderous monster.

Title: 466. Dragon Ball: Mystical Adventure
description: Goku and Krillin are invited to participate in a martial arts tournament taking place in the country of Mifan, where a desperate emperor needs help.

Title: 467. Bokura no nanoka-kan sensô
description: Junior-high students are restrained by their teachers and parents... One day, they plan a rebellion.

Title: 468. The Little Devil
description: During an exorcism, father Maurice meets a little devil named Giuditta, who refuses to return to hell and decides to discover the world.

Title: 469. Zelly and Me
description: A young orphan who lives with her grandmother in a large house in Virginia is infatuated with the voices of Joan of Arc. Her nanny seeks the help of a wealthy suitor to take her and the orphan.

Title: 470. The Head Hunter
description: Miami cop Pete is having a tough time: first he learns his wife is having an affair with another woman (they split up), then him and his partner Kat are pitted against a shape-shifting voodoo demon from Africa who is decapitating and possessing people. Pete and Kat race against time to stop him before he can kill or possess anyone else.

Title: 471. Cemetery High
description: A group of High School girls with guns go on a killing spree. They are intent on ridding the world of scummy men.

Title: 472. SOS - en segelsällskapsresa
description: The landlubber Stig-Helmer and his Norwegian friend Ole get on a barge by mistake. They arrive to an island in the archipelago and have to spend Midsummer among the fancy rich people, their champagne parties, their summer houses and the annual yacht race.

Title: 473. Stealing Heaven
description: In medieval Paris, a young religious scholar and the beautiful niece of a local patrician fall madly in love and consummate their passion for each other. In the religious uproar that follows, they are condemned and brutally punished.

Title: 474. Dracula's Widow
description: The young owner of a wax factory in Hollywood receives six instead of five boxes ordered with Romanian antiques. He doesn't know that Vanessa, widow of Count Dracula, sleeps in the sixth chest.

Title: 475. The Lion's Den
description: The Peruvian anti-terrorist army takes control of a far away and unknown small village isolated in the Andes by the terrorist militia "Sendero Luminoso" (Shining Path), during the dirty war in Peru at 80's decade.

Title: 476. Dial Help
description: A psychic finds herself tapping into the "energy" of a deceased phone operator. She also finds that her friends soon begin dying mysteriously. An investigator determines to track down the cause.

Title: 477. Little Sweetheart
description: A criminal couple, hiding out in a remote property become the unwitting victims of a plot to blackmail them by the most unlikely of conspirators.

Title: 478. Trishagni
description: The film is set in a Central Asian desert in the 1st Century B.C. A sandstorm strikes the Buddhist town of Sariput, leaving just four survivors - two monks and two children - in the upper floor of a monastery.

Title: 479. Iguana
description: In the 19th century, a bullied, disfigured man dubbed Iguana flees from abusive locals, finds his own island and declares himself tyrant of his new domain. A man and a woman get stranded there and become victims of his new sadistic nature.

Title: 480. Scorpion Thunderbolt
description: An evil witch seeks a magic ring which is currently in the possession of a mustachieod disciple of black magic. Meanwhile a snake monster terrorizes the city of Hong Kong.

Title: 481. Strul
description: A chemistry teacher is framed for making drugs. In prison he discovers a passage out. A gang forces him to reveal it and join them in their crimes outside, returning each time. He meets a cutie that turns out to be a cop.

Title: 482. Robo Vampire
description: Narcotics agent Tom Wilde is given a second chance at life after being shot and killed. In a futuristic experiment, agent Wilde is returned to life as an Android Robot and he is sent on a very dangerous mission.

Title: 483. Glitch!
description: Two thieves in the process of robbing a movie producer's mansion are forced to pretend they're the owners of the property, and proceed to hold an audition for an exploitation movie with a hundred auditioning women.

Title: 484. Deadly Dreams
description: From the director of the highly acclaimed "Body Chemistry," comes a frightening excursion into terror. Alex is caught in a web of distrust between his brother, his best friend, a beautiful stranger and the renewed dreams of the slaughter of his family.

Title: 485. I Live with Me Dad
description: Sid is a down on his luck single father, but with his son Crispy they share all the joys and disappointments that street life can bring.

Title: 486. Senior Week
description: Everett and his party-hungry buddies embark on an all-night road-trip to the Florida beaches, for a week of fun, sun, and beautiful women. Mayhem ensues when 2 jealous girl-friends show up unexpectedly, along with a psycho teacher who's hunting down Everett because he owes her an overdue term-paper.

Title: 487. Time of Violence
description: In the 17th century, a Bulgarian Christian region is selected by the Ottoman rulers to serve as an example of conversion to Islam. A Janissary who was kidnapped from the village as a boy is sent to force the reluctant inhabitants to convert. The Turkish governor seeks a peaceful solution, but ultimately torture, violence, and rebellion break out.

Title: 488. Twice Dead
description: A family moves into an old house. They start getting harassed by a gang, who eventually invade the house while the parents are away and start terrorizing the kids, but they didn't account for the deadly supernatural presence in the house.

Title: 489. Wildfire
description: Since they met the first time in boarding school as little kids, it was obvious that the orphans Kay and Dave would become a couple. But at sixteen, Dave foolishly attempted to rob a bank with a water pistol, and ended up in jail for eight years. Meanwhile Kay was sent to foster parents, where she met the successful business man Mike, whom she married and bore two kids. Now Frank is released from prison and immediately starts wooing Kay again. Although she's happy with Mike, she can't withdraw herself completely. Old memories and her husband's jealousy make her spend more and more time with him.

Title: 490. Tales from the Gimli Hospital
description: While their mother is dying in the modern Gimli, Manitoba hospital, two young children are told a tale by their Icelandic grandmother about Einar the Lonely, his friend Gunnar, and the angelic Snjofridur in a Gimli of old.

Title: 491. Kabzaa
description: Ranjit Verma is lawyer to criminal Veljibhai who gets involved with Ranjit's brother, Ravi. Veljibhai, with the help of Ravi, tries to steal the property of Ustad Ali.

Title: 492. In the Line of Duty III
description: Genji Nakamura and his soul-mate and partner Michiko Nishiwaki are thieves for the notorious Red Army terrorist organization in Japan. After pulling off the jewelry heist of the century (in which dozens of people get killed including a Tokyo detective), they are now planning to use the jewelry they've snatched to buy an arms cache from gun smugglers in Hong Kong for their movement. But when the duo learns the jewelry is fake and that their co-conspirator has set them up, they are determined to get what is owed to them even if they have to tear Hong Kong inside out. But lovely Hong Kong inspector Rachel Yeung is on the scene and she's not having any kind of bloodbath on her watch. After recently being promoted to 'Madam' for the S.C.S. (Serious Crimes Section), Rachel is determined to bust Michiko and Nakamura anyway she can when their violence results in too many casualties. But Rachel finds herself at odds with her bumbling uncle Cameron Chung, the head inspector for the S.C.S., as he feels this case is too dangerous for her and assigns Rachel to be a police escort for Officer Fujioka, a quiet but determined Tokyo police officer who is in town for his own personal reasons...reasons which could spell trouble for Rachel when she learns that he has a personal vendetta against Michiko and Nakamura. As the action hits overdrive filled with chases, gun fights and some serious hand-to-hand combat from both sides, it leads to a brutal but nasty showdown pitting cop against criminal...and only those with something to lose may be the ones to walk away from this encounter alive.

Title: 493. Khoon Bhari Maang
description: A man marries a rich widow for her money and tries to murder her but she survives, gets a new face thanks to plastic surgery, and returns for revenge.

Title: 494. Emerald City
description: A couple is being tested by the temptations of a big city.

Title: 495. Raiders of the Magic Ivory
description: Two mercenaries are hired by a Chinese businessman to find an ivory tablet that supposedly has magic powers and is hidden deep in the jungles of North Vietnam, protected by soldiers, cannibalistic monks and witch doctors. The businessman will pay $250,000 for the tablet, but he has plans for the tablet--and the mercenaries--that they know nothing about.

Title: 496. Fatal Pulse
description: A girl is killed and raped minutes after fighting with her boyfriend (Jeff) and he left her. Jeff is the assistant of professor Caldwell at the university, and he wanted to return with his old girlfriend (Lisa). The girl lived with another five girls, including Lisa. All these girls begin to be killed, one by one, in different and strange ways. The main suspect is Jeff.

Title: 497. Another Chance
description: John Ripley, a soap star and playboy, falls in love with Jackie, a cover girl for his agent Russ Wilder. After losing her, he realizes Jackie was the best thing he ever had and embarks on a long journey to recover.

Title: 498. The Bengali Night
description: A British engineer becomes entangled in a forbidden romance with his Indian employer's eldest daughter. As their passion ignites, the East-meets-West clash of cultures leads to surprising and tragic consequences.

Title: 499. Screwball Hotel
description: Three boys drop out of military school. They get jobs working at a hotel, but it's about to go under. They decide to help the owner raise enough money to stay in business. They prove that sex sells by holding "Miss Purity Pageant" starring some of the females staying at the hotel.

Title: 500. The Carrier
description: Jake carries a disease that doesn't harm him but makes objects he touches deadly - they dissolve anyone else who contacts them. Only he knows he's the carrier. People test items with cats and wear bags for protection.

Title: 501. Bernadette
description: In 1857, a miller's impoverished family settles in grim lodgings. In 1858, their sickly 14-year-old daughter Bernadette experiences visions of a woman at the Massabielle grotto, sparking events.

Title: 502. Perfect Victims
description: A psycho who has contracted AIDS blames women for his disease, and begins to stalk and kill beautiful girls.

Title: 503. Doomed Megalopolis: The Last Megalopolis
description: A demonic reincarnation of a Japanese general from the 10th century appears in the early 20th century Tokyo with a mission to destroy the blooming city.

Title: 504. Vijay
description: Vijay is a story about people that are bound by relationships of love and friendship and how they become foes and take up weapons against each other.

Title: 505. Buy & Cell
description: Herbie Altman is framed for Stock fraud by his boss when the SEC starts investigating his company. Sent to prison, he helps a fellow inmate successfully invest his money. Soon all the inmates want his help. To manage all the money, he forms CON INC. and runs it from the prison under the noses of the warden and the guards. But when the IRS and SEC begin to investigate this successful company, it looks like he may be in trouble again.

Title: 506. Bloodstone
description: An American couple on a business trip to Bangalore, India is dragged into the theft of a ruby called 'Bloodstone'. The wife is kidnapped, and the husband teams up with a resourceful taxi driver to free his wife and retrieve the ruby.

Title: 507. Saturday the 14th Strikes Back
description: Eddie and his family have just inherited a spooky wreck of a house. What they do not know about the house is that it was built over an evil passage way, but they are soon to discover the wacky evil it releases.

Title: 508. Chicken and Duck Talk
description: Old Hui, the stingy owner of a traditional BBQ duck restaurant, has to fight to retain customers defecting to a new fast-food fried chicken joint just across the street.

Title: 509. Future Hunters
description: A man from a post-apocalyptic future travels back in time to prevent the coming nuclear holocaust and enlists the help of a young couple.

Title: 510. Summertime Blues
description: It's summertime and Johnny hits upon the idea of restoring a disused old bar with his old friends Benny and Bobby. Raising the capital however is a problem, but luckily the landlord's geeky daughter Polly has long harboured a crush on Bobby. Bobby wants no part of this and neither does Polly who smells a rat.
